title: Plaid products
description: A pale section with a big two-line navy heading and a near-black pill, then a bento of soft cyan-to-lavender cards (two wide, three narrow; stacked on phones). Each card has a two-tone title (bold lead-in, blue-grey rest), a round arrow button and a product picture rising from the bottom. On hover a rainbow rim fades in and slowly spins around the card, the arrow fills navy and the picture lifts; on touch screens the card in the middle of the view gets the same state as you scroll.
notes: media slot per card: a product UI picture (about 300×300 frame); the card's own background picture becomes the soft gradient surface
the touch-screen 'active in view' state needs CSS scroll-driven animations; elsewhere cards simply rest
